self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Silent Trigger (R5): on hit, deal AoE DMG equal to 80% of Max HP at the target's location (triggers at most once every 15s). No eval-time key models a standalone Max-HP-scaled bonus damage instance, so this is approximated as a flat +5% all_dmg_ uplift representing the averaged DPS contribution of the periodic proc for a moderate-HP build; the real value scales with the wielder's actual Max HP and rotation length.

en.flavor: A mechanical longbow purpose-built for long shots and silent kills. Its twang is swallowed up amidst the night, the note lengthy and cold.

fr.flavor: Un arc long mécanique spécialement conçu pour les tirs lointains et les éliminations silencieuses. Son son est englouti par la nuit, sa note longue et froide...
